analysis.ambiguity1: The course catalog is ugly. I just want to drag and drop classes into a calendar to see if they fit. I want the app to warn me if I am choosing a class that starts at 8:00 AM because I will definitely oversleep.
analysis.ambiguity2: Student data is sensitive. Under no circumstances should a student be able to see another student schedule. Also, the system must log every time an advisor manually overrides a prerequisite for audit purposes.
analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict: The Head of Advising wants students to be able to plan their roadmaps 4 years ahead regardless of course availability, whereas the Registrar states that students shouldn't be able to add a class if it is already full according to the live database.

Proposed Solution: Allow students to add any course to their long-term roadmap as a "Draft/Planned" status for future semesters. However, for the current or upcoming registration term, the system will validate against the live database; if a class is full, it will display a visual warning or add the student to a waiting list rather than blocking long-term planning.
